categorizationMenu.name: HUD Item Categorization
categorizationMenu.label: Configure Categorization
categorizationMenu.hint: Define custom category sections, sub-sections, and boolean expressions for filtering HUD items.

moduleIntegrationsMenu.label: Configure Module Integrations
moduleIntegrationsMenu.hint: Configure options and behaviors for integrated third-party modules active in this world.

enableCenterOnToken.name: Center on Token Button
enableCenterOnToken.hint: Display a button in the HUD control bar to recenter the canvas view on the active token.

autoCenterOnToken.name: Auto-Center on Token
autoCenterOnToken.hint: Automatically recenters the canvas view when combat advances to a token you are in charge of.

enableItemSummaryButton.name: Item Summary Tooltip Button
enableItemSummaryButton.hint: Display a ? button in the HUD control bar to toggle rich item summary tooltips without holding the ? key.

enableToggleHotkey.name: Enable HUD Toggle Hotkey
enableToggleHotkey.hint: Allow players to toggle open or close the Action Display HUD using the configured keybinding (default: Shift+Space).

enableCombatButtons.name: Combat Action Buttons
enableCombatButtons.hint: Display contextual combat buttons (e.g. Roll Initiative, End Turn) in the HUD footer during combat.

enableCombatAutoTrackButton.name: Combat Auto-Track Button
enableCombatAutoTrackButton.hint: Display a combat turn tracking button (sword icon) in the HUD control bar to automatically follow the active character's turn during combat.

economyColorsMenu.label: Configure Colors
economyColorsMenu.hint: Customize the indicator bar color for each action economy type for this system.

hudConfigMenu.name: HUD Configuration
hudConfigMenu.label: Configure HUD
hudConfigMenu.hint: Customize HUD opacity, scale, font size, attachment side, and grid offsets.

hudOpacity.name: HUD Opacity
hudOpacity.hint: Controls the transparency of the Action Display HUD overlay.

hudScale.name: HUD Scale
hudScale.hint: Controls the overall scale of the HUD window and all its contents proportionally.

fontSize.name: Font Size (px)
fontSize.hint: Controls the base font size of the text and icons. The HUD window size will remain independent.

persistTabState.name: Persist Tab Selections
persistTabState.hint: If enabled, your active tab selections for each character are saved and restored whenever you re-open the HUD or refresh Foundry.

persistHUD.name: Persist HUD on Click-Off
persistHUD.hint: Controls whether the HUD stays open across outside clicks until right-clicking the token or explicitly closing.

toggleTabSelection.name: Toggle Tab Selections on Left-Click
toggleTabSelection.hint: If enabled, left-clicking a tab toggles its selection on or off (multi-select) instead of clearing other selected tabs. Selections are only cleared by clicking them again or clicking 'All'.

hudAnchorSide.name: HUD Attachment Side
hudAnchorSide.hint: Controls whether the Attached HUD anchors vertically (Above / Below) or horizontally (Left / Right) relative to the token.

hudGridOffset.name: HUD Grid Offset (Vertical)
hudGridOffset.hint: Controls the vertical distance (in grid units) to offset the HUD above or below the token.

hudGridOffsetHorizontal.name: HUD Grid Offset (Horizontal)
hudGridOffsetHorizontal.hint: Controls the horizontal distance (in grid units) to offset the HUD to the left or right of the token.

showTooltips.name: Show Tooltips
showTooltips.hint: Display contextual hover tooltips for HUD control buttons, page options, and tab right-click actions.

logVerbosity.name: Log Verbosity Level
logVerbosity.hint: Controls the level of detail printed to the browser console.

categorization.title: Bakana's HUD Categorization Configuration
categorization.noCategories: No custom categories defined. Click '+ Add Category' to start.
categorization.invalidExpressionWarning: The expression "{expr}" contains a syntax error.

expressionHelp.evaluation: Actions are evaluated against each category from top to bottom and placed in the first matching rule ({true}).
expressionHelp.fallthrough: {fallthrough}: When enabled on a category, matching actions appear in that category and continue evaluating into later categories as though they haven't been matched yet.

economyColors.title: Action Economy Colors
economyColors.description: Configure the colored vertical bars used to indicate action economy for each action type.

moduleIntegrations.title: Module Integration Configuration
moduleIntegrations.description: Configure options and feature toggles for supported third-party modules active in this world.
moduleIntegrations.noActiveModules: No supported module integrations are currently active in this world.

filterAutomationOnly.name: Filter Automation-Only Activities
filterAutomationOnly.hint: When enabled, activities flagged as automation-only by Midi-QOL are ignored entirely by the Action Display HUD.

hudConfig.title: Configure HUD
hudConfig.description: Customize the appearance, scaling, and token attachment offsets for the Action Display HUD.

combatTrack.label: Combat Turn Tracker
combatTrack.tooltip: Left Click: Follow Active Combatant Turn Right Click: Toggle Auto-Open / Auto-Close on Turn Change

recenter.label: Recenter View
recenter.tooltip: Left Click: Recenter Canvas on Active Combatant Right Click: Toggle Auto-Centering on Turn Change

anchor.label: HUD Placement & Persistence
anchor.tooltipAttached: Left Click: Detach HUD from Token Right Click: Toggle HUD Persistence on Outside Click
anchor.tooltipDetached: Left Click: Attach HUD to Token Right Click: Toggle HUD Persistence on Outside Click

toggleHUD.hint: Open or close the Action Display HUD for the currently controlled token.
